schema.description: RunSessionHookResponse is the run that was queued.

run.description: The queued run (state pending); the VM's runner picks it up on its next poll.

attempt.description:
Attempt number of this hook on this session, starting at 1 ("Run again"
and every restore add one).

exitCode.description:
Exit code of the script, once it exited. 124 means RDE ended the run
because On create did not finish within its limit.

finishedAt.description: When the script process exited (or the run was interrupted / skipped).

hook.description:
The hook: "on_create", "on_claim", "on_restore", or the platform's own
"personalize" step (the personal setup queued before On claim for a
personal owner).

ranIn.description:
Where it ran: "pool" (inside a warm pool, with the pool's shared inputs,
before any claim) or "session" (on the owned session).
